how_to_read_this: output_before is what the model in memory predicted for the first eight rows of the dataset; output_after is what the same model predicted after being written to the artifact format and read back. They are compared exactly, not within a tolerance. Rerun one row with 'MPLBACKEND=Agg .venv/bin/python scripts/check_artifact_roundtrip.py --only <model>'.

rows.detail: A Birch model cannot be written in a format that does not execute on load, so this run cannot be exported as a bundle. Its results, model card and manifest are unaffected.
